title: OpenNWM: A Generalist Navigation World Model with Latent Action Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.01844v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Navigation world models predict future observations conditioned on navigation actions to support planning, but their generalization across real-world environments remains constrained by the limited coverage of action-labeled data. Action-free navigation videos provide diverse visual experience, yet lack the recorded actions required for action-conditioned training. We introduce OpenNWM, a generalist navigation world model with latent action pretraining. It learns universal latent actions from large-scale action-free videos through visual prediction pretraining, and further aligns them with physical motions via action-conditioned post-training. To support video pretraining, we curate NavAnywhere, a large-scale action-free navigation video dataset comprising 17.5 million visual observations from 15 heterogeneous sources. translated_title: OpenNWM：具有潜在动作预训练的通用导航世界模型
translated_abstract: 导航世界模型通过以导航动作为条件预测未来观测来支持规划，但其在真实世界环境中的泛化能力仍受限于带动作标注数据覆盖范围的不足。无动作导航视频提供了丰富多样的视觉经验，却缺少动作条件训练所需的记录动作。我们提出OpenNWM，一个采用潜在动作预训练的通用导航世界模型。该方法通过视觉预测预训练从大规模无动作视频中学习通用的潜在动作，再通过动作条件后训练将这些潜在动作与物理运动对齐。为支持视频预训练，我们构建了NavAnywhere数据集，这是一个大规模无动作导航视频数据集，包含来自15个异构数据源的1750万个视觉观测，涵盖了地面机器人、人类和无人机的导航行为，具有多样的视角和运动模式。
tldr: OpenNWM通过视觉预测预训练从1750万条无动作导航视频中学习通用潜在动作，并结合动作条件后训练将其与物理运动对齐，从而构建出一个能跨真实环境泛化的通用导航世界模型。
